brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536x864 or larger, PNG. This is for バスケまとめ.

VISUAL STYLE: The approved style is a near-black #151A18 background with electric lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes, ivory-white typography and ink figure, very bold condensed Japanese sans-serif headlines, strong handmade brush/ink texture, sparse elements, editorial poster quality. Orange is reserved for one basketball held/dribbled by the player. Not photorealistic. Do not use a photo collage.

CONTENT: The frozen article says there were NO GAMES on 2026-10-28 in B.PREMIER, B.ONE, B.NEXT. This was information retrieved 2026-10-29 10:38–10:39 JST and official records can change. There is no player named in the article. The depicted player was selected randomly as an illustrative motif; do not claim any appearance, result, performance or actual event involving him.

PERSON: Draw exactly one real player, Shuta Hara (原修太), in a powerful low left-handed dribble drive. The club's official 2026-27 portrait was visually checked: Japanese adult man, broad muscular shoulders and thick upper arms; a broad oval face tapering to a softly squared chin, fuller cheeks, straight substantial dark eyebrows, narrower dark almond eyes, a straight medium-width nose, medium full lips, no beard or mustache. Distinctive dark chestnut brown medium-short hair, loosely parted near the middle, voluminous sweeping curtain-like front locks revealing the center forehead, sides covering the upper temples, NOT a buzz cut or spiky hair. Preserve these specific likeness cues, do not invent a generic player. Plain ivory basketball jersey and shorts with dark ink shadows; NO logo, sponsor, player name, team lettering or jersey number. New illustrated pose, not a copied photo: three-quarter view, bent knees, leaning into a drive, left hand in convincing contact with upper/side surface of the ball near hip/thigh, right arm bent naturally. One ball and exactly two hands with anatomically correct fingers. His face must remain big, readable and unobscured.

COMPOSITION: Typography occupies roughly left 55%, the dynamic player right 43%. Figure from head to knees, with head, both hands and ball fully inside the canvas and generous edge clearance. His movement and a curved lime brush trail create a diagonal different from a shooting pose. No hoop, opponents, crowd, arena, scoreboard or invented game scene. Keep background simple and abstract. This is expressly an imaginary illustration, not recreation of a match.

TEXT, render these exact strings with correct Japanese, no other text:
Top left small masthead: 「バスケまとめ」
Below masthead, prominent white date: 「2026.10.28」
Largest dominant lime Japanese headline, one line if possible: 「試合なし」
Below headline, medium white league scope: 「B.PREMIER・B.ONE・B.NEXT」
Below that, smaller readable white qualifier: 「10/29 10:38〜10:39 JST取得時点」
Next small line: 「最新情報は公式サイトで」
Bottom, readable label with wide margins: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Next to the AI label: 「イメージ」

All text must remain within 5% safe margins and never touch the player or brush splatters. Preserve comfortable spacing and clean typographic hierarchy. Date must be 10.28, not today. No player name and no player statistics anywhere. No inherited names, score or 38 from any style reference. No league or team logos, no sponsor marks, no official photos, no watermark.
